questions.question: In 42, who does Harrison Ford play?
questions.note: The Brooklyn Dodgers executive who signs Robinson. Chadwick Boseman plays Jackie. 2013.

questions.question: Which James Bond actor co-stars with Harrison Ford in Cowboys & Aliens?
questions.note: Craig plays amnesiac outlaw Jake Lonergan opposite Ford’s Colonel Dolarhyde.

questions.question: Ender’s Game is adapted from a novel by which author?
questions.note: Ford plays Colonel Hyrum Graff in the 2013 adaptation of Card’s science-fiction novel.

questions.question: In The Devil’s Own, what is Ford’s Tom O’Meara?
questions.note: He takes in a boarder. It goes badly at the dinner table.

questions.question: In The Devil’s Own, Ford’s cop takes in a lodger who is secretly what?
questions.note: The young Irishman is in New York to finish a job. O’Meara thought he was helping a kid.

questions.question: Who directed The Devil’s Own (1997)?
questions.note: Pakula’s last film. He had already made Presumed Innocent with Ford.

questions.question: In What Lies Beneath, what is Ford’s Norman Spencer hiding?
choices: That the house is not his
questions.note: His wife thinks the house is haunted. The ghost is the student.

questions.question: Which actor plays television producer Becky Fuller opposite Ford in Morning Glory?
questions.note: McAdams plays the producer trying to save a morning show by pairing Ford with Diane Keaton.

questions.question: Which actor plays the ageless Adaline opposite Harrison Ford in The Age of Adaline?
questions.note: Ford plays William Jones, who recognizes Adaline from a romance decades earlier.

questions.question: Which late actor played Thaddeus Ross in the MCU before Harrison Ford took over?
questions.note: William Hurt played Ross from The Incredible Hulk through Black Widow. Ford assumed the role in Captain America: Brave New World.
